			static bool discard_state;

			void discard_cond(bool fragment_unnamed_2806)
			{
				if (fragment_unnamed_2806)
				{
					discard_state = true;
				}
			}

			void discard_exit()
			{
				if (discard_state)
				{
					discard;
				}
			}

			void frag_main()
			{
				discard_state = false;
				float fragment_unnamed_127 = fragment_input_2.w * fragment_uniform_buffer_0[14u].z;
				float fragment_unnamed_128 = fragment_input_4.w * fragment_uniform_buffer_0[14u].z;
				float fragment_unnamed_141 = fragment_input_2.w + ((-0.0f) - fragment_uniform_buffer_1[4u].x);

			float4x4 unity_MatrixMVP;

			struct Vertex_Stage_Input
			{
				float3 pos : POSITION;
			};

			struct Vertex_Stage_Output
			{
				float4 pos : SV_POSITION;
			};

			Vertex_Stage_Output vert(Vertex_Stage_Input input)
			{
				Vertex_Stage_Output output;
				output.pos = mul(unity_MatrixMVP, float4(input.pos, 1.0));
				return output;
			}

			float4 frag(Vertex_Stage_Output input) : SV_TARGET
			{
				// Output solid grey color (e.g., 50% grey)
				return float4(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0); // RGBA
			}

				float3 vertex_input_1 : NORMAL; // NORMAL

				float4 vertex_input_3 : COLOR; // TEXCOORD_1
				float4 vertex_input_4 : TEXCOORD0; // COLOR

			};

			{
				float4 vertex_output_0 : INTERNALTESSPOS; // INTERNALTESSPOS
				float3 vertex_output_1 : NORMAL; // NORMAL
				float4 vertex_output_2 : TEXCOORD; // TEXCOORD
				float4 vertex_output_3 : TEXCOORD1; // TEXCOORD_1
				float4 vertex_output_4 : COLOR; // COLOR
				float4 vertex_output_5 : TANGENT; // TANGENT
			};

			void vert_main()
			{
				vertex_output_0.x = vertex_input_0.x;
				vertex_output_0.y = vertex_input_0.y;
				vertex_output_0.z = vertex_input_0.z;
				vertex_output_0.w = vertex_input_0.w;
				vertex_output_1.x = vertex_input_1.x;
				vertex_output_1.y = vertex_input_1.y;

			#ifndef ANY_SHADER_VARIANT_ACTIVE

			// https://docs.unity3d.com/Manual/SL-UnityShaderVariables.html
			float4x4 unity_MatrixMVP;

			struct Vertex_Stage_Input
			{
				float3 pos : POSITION;
			};

			struct Vertex_Stage_Output
			{
				float4 pos : SV_POSITION;
			};

			Vertex_Stage_Output vert(Vertex_Stage_Input input)
			{
				Vertex_Stage_Output output;
				output.pos = mul(unity_MatrixMVP, float4(input.pos, 1.0));
				return output;
			}

			float4 frag(Vertex_Stage_Output input) : SV_TARGET
			{
				// Output solid grey color (e.g., 50% grey)
				return float4(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0); // RGBA
			}

			#endif // !ANY_SHADER_VARIANT_ACTIVE
